what_happened: Located the antitone obstruction's exact currency inside one file pair: HasForwardSlack is the UPPER direction of anchor_clause_of_first_region_start's two-sided collapse, and hasForwardSlack_raise_of_zero already compiles 'a raise of z's region by d*l buys exactly d*l of slack from no hypothesis at all'. That makes the free-anchor raise's lower bound RELAXABLE by exactly m*(P+1) rather than only removable, which the named route did not anticipate.

Ten compiled probes all green on first attempt, every arithmetic obligation closing by a single omega after intro. The antitone slice split into a bounded-descent half (dispatchable with no new hypothesis family) and a deep-descent residue (the named route, now priced at exactly (n-n') - m*(P+1)); the predecessor's own non-vacuity witness (4,2)/(6,0) turned out to sit in the cheaper half at j = m = 2.

First lean_run_code probe batch failed on 'import Mathlib.Tactic.Omega' -- no such module in this Mathlib pin (omega is Lean core). Re-ran with 'import Init' and all probes compiled. Cost one round trip.

All ten of the research report's compiled probes (1, 1b, 2, 4, 8, 10 arithmetic; 5, 6, 7 kappa) were re-derived green at plan-authoring time via lean_run_code, zero diagnostics on the kappa set and only unused-variable linter warnings on the arithmetic set. Carried-figure discipline discharged by re-derivation rather than by a CARRIED-UNVERIFIED mark.

A new record not in the research report was compiled at plan time: ForwardSlackWitnessed at amount 0 is FREE (provable from mem_cellAt_ladder_iff plus hasForwardSlack_zero, zero diagnostics). This collapses the report's two proposed schemas (items 5 and 6, a bounded-sub-slice schema with no upward hypothesis plus a separate deep-descent one) into ONE exhaustive schema whose upward payment is the truncated Nat subtraction (n - n') - m*(P+1), which is literally 0 on the bounded sub-slice. The bounded half's freedom becomes a compiled corollary instead of a second schema.

The plan widens the task's declared file_scope: two of the fifteen declarations must land in LadderChain.lean, which the dispatch's file_scope did not name and which parent task 910's plan declared a non-goal. Unavoidable, not drift: the regime-A raise DISCARDS the habove clause its own inner call returns (LadderChain.lean:1013), and the lowered exact-shift deletion hard-codes hk : n0 + k = nxtAt g z in its signature, so neither the raise-bought slack nor the raising direction is reachable by any reading of landed material from the cell layer. LadderChain.lean is in no other non-terminal task's file_scope. plan-file-scope-harvest.sh will re-harvest the widened scope from the plan's Files to modify blocks at plan-postflight.

Phase 1's five declarations compiled first try with the plan's pinned proofs verbatim; all five had been pre-compiled at plan time via lean_run_code, so the planning-dispatch probe investment paid off directly as zero debugging cycles.

Plan Phase 2 pinned the new theorem's placement as 'section AssemblyFin, immediately after exists_ladderPath_through_shifted_of_pend_past', but HasForwardSlack (LadderChain.lean:1218, section DelNxt) and hasForwardSlack_raise (:1347, section Slack) are both declared BELOW section AssemblyFin (844-1066). A declaration whose conclusion mentions HasForwardSlack therefore cannot sit in AssemblyFin at all. Landed at the end of section Slack instead; pinned signature unchanged, placement reason recorded in the docstring. Planning dispatch verified the habove discard and the recovery idiom by line-read but did not check the declaration ORDER of the symbols the new clause needs.
